CHIME TIME STORIES
FUNNY FAH

In a Palace far away lives a kindly old man His name is Master Chi Lu Every day his little chimes provide the palace visitors with happy relaxing melodies.MaterChi Lu loves to be involved in their adventures. This is the story of little
FUNNY FAH.

FUNNY FAH learns when to STOP!
One morning when the breeze began to blow, the colourful chimes woke up and started to bump into their chime plates A lovely, tinkling song began to float on the breeze Can you see
Funny Fah He is the little red chime.
Master ChiLu is very, very happy when he hears the music.

And all the little chimes are happy too.
Funny Fah is very happy He is always telling funny jokes.
He shouts, “Why did the banana go to the doctor The others wait for him.

Every evening before the sun sets the
Palace workers put away their mowers and rakes and gardening tools.
The birds in the trees whistle their last little songs for the day.
Even the tree is happy Can you see the big smile?

The little chimes start to yawn and take turns sleeping on the little chime plates behind them.
Each chime has a colourful pillow.
Master Chi Lu puts a blanket over them on the cool nights The wind blows cold off the mountains near the Palace.
The worker putting the rake away is really happy tonight. He can see the little chimes through the window.

Guess what happened when it was
Funny Fah's turn to go to bed.
He could not resist one more joke.
But it was time for sleep, not for jokes.
"Knock, knock!" he shouted. “GO TO
SLEEP!" they all replied. But Funny Fah was laughing loudly like a kookaburra.
"Koo! Koo! Kah! Kah!"
Little Soh started to cry. "Please go to sleep p Funny Fah. We want quiet time now." She pulled her blanket over her ears so she couldn't hear him giggling into his pillow.

The evening breeze had stopped and everything went hush Master Chi
Lu tucked little blankets around their ears Some were sleeping on the chime plate while the others folded their hands and dozed off.
They were hanging on the strings tied to the bell shaped top plate over their heads Some of the little chimes watched the moon moving past the window until they fell asleep.

The only sound to be heard when Master Chi
Lu left the room was naughty little Fah still giggling away on his pillow.
The bright moonlight was casting shadows through the window Everyone felt safe and sound around Master Chi Lu'sPalace.
But,let's see what happens a short time later!

Funny Fah was almost asleep when heard a rustling sound outside the window. He lifted his head up with a jerk! The baubles on his hat began to shake.
His mouth h dropped open. His teeth started to chatter...

What was he looking at? The bright moonbeams had suddenly darkened and a scary shape moved near the window. It moved away then it moved back again and came even nearer to him. What is it?
His heart started to say, "Boomp! Boomp! Boomp!"
Funny Fah's eyes were popping open.

Everyone else was asleep Funny Fah struggled, he didn't want to scream! He whispered,“who's there Are you coming to get me Mr Monster?" Then he shouted, “A-a- a-h! Go away, Mr Monster! Wake up wake up everyone wake up!"
The monster suddenly moved away from the window.BynowFunnyFahwasbightinghis knuckles and shaking madly.
Funny Fah longed for his friends to wake up.
He leaned over and shook Little Tee.

"Little Tee, Little Tee. Wake up!"
She angrily shouted Go to sleep Funny Fah No more jokes,ple-e-e-e-a-se."
"But there sa monster just outside the window.
I'm not joking I saw a monster!
LittleTimid Tee said Yeh Yeh A monster we know that one Go to sleep!"
All the rest just folded their arms and turned the other way.
"Oh! No!" Funny Fah suddenly realised.

Funny Fah looked back at the window The monster had gone He looked and looked and looked The monster has gone and I'm the only one who saw it!"he thought.
He leaned back on his pillow and wished the others would believe him.
"Why didn't they believe me?" he asked.
Now he couldn't sleep.l

Tears rolled down his cheeks He wondered and wondered.
"I was just trying to let them know about the monster Why wouldn'tthey listen to me?
What will I do if the monster comes back?"

"1 tickled little Tee.
I said Knock, knockwho'sthere?
I told funny jokes."
What did I do wrong?
Funny Fah is thinking about his friends not the monster.

Next day the sun shone brightly on the Palace.
Master ChiLu placed the little chimes outside in the breeze Soon they were playing songs.

Funny Fah still tells jokes but now he is
REALLY different He is careful not to offend his friends He doesn't play tricks if it might hurt someone And he has promised he will not keep his friends awake when they ask him to STOP He really wants to be friends with
EVERYONE.
Do you think he has learned a lesson?
Do you know what Funny Fah saw?
Was it really a monster?

It was actually the gardener collecting some of the tools to put them away.
See, here is the gardener collecting the rakes and clippers.

Can you see the moon shadow of the gardener?
Funny Fah thought the gardener was a monster moving back and forth near the window He thought the rakes and clippers the gardener is carrying look like the claws of a space monster.
The gardener moved away from the window before the other chimes saw him That swhy little Tee shouted at Funny Fah She was sure he would not STOP his joking Was she right?

Funny Fah still does not know who the
"monster was.
And the other chimes have noticed how happy Funny
Fah is now.
Would you tell
Funny Fah the gardener collecting his rakes in the moonlight was not a monster?
